def test_orders_end_to_end_workflow():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    address_payload = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json()["id"]

    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json()["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item = items[0]
    item_id = item["id"]
    unit_price = item["price"]

    cart_item_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o["id"] == order_id for o in orders), "Order not found in history"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    payments = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(payments, list) and len(payments) > 0, "Expected payment authorization"
    assert payments[0].get("authorised") is True, "Expected payment to be authorised"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    shipment = resp.json()
    assert shipment.get("orderId") == order_id, "Expected shipment for order"

def test_carts_merge_workflow():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Merge",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    session_id = f"session_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item = items[0]

    cart_item_payload = {
        "itemId": item["id"],
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": item["price"]
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json=cart_item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert len(cart_items) > 0, "Cart is empty after merge"
    assert any(i["itemId"] == item["id"] for i in cart_items), "Item not found in merged cart"

def test_catalogue_tags_and_size():
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/tags"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    tags_data = resp.json()
    tags = tags_data.get("tags", [])
    if not tags:
        return

    tag = tags[0]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/size?tags={tag}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue?tags={tag}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(items, list), "Expected a list of items"

def test_user_login_and_profile():

    password = "securepassword"
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",

    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
